# FindMy homepage

FindMy presents a local discovery experience for South Africa. The homepage introduces food, travel, services, property, events, cars, and insurance. It also shows sample trending listings, handpicked collections, platform information, FAQs, and business information.

## Current routes
- `/` — homepage
- `/robots.txt` — crawler instructions
- `/sitemap.xml` — route index
- `/llms.txt` — concise agent guide

## Interface
- The search field matches a query to a category preview on the current page; it does not call a listings API.
- The location selector changes the city shown in the current browser session only.
- Trending cards are marked as sample listings for layout review.
- FAQ answers open with native HTML disclosure elements.
- Newsletter submission shows that the service is not yet connected and does not save an email address.
- Account and business actions are visual previews until real services and authorization are integrated.

## Implementation
The homepage is statically generated with Next.js App Router. The hero uses separate desktop and mobile WebP assets with eager loading. Images below the first viewport use lazy loading and reserved aspect ratios. Client-side code is limited to interactive controls.
